summary: Media playback buffer allocation and setup. Allocates an 80-byte buffer through the sub-allocator at this+0x4, stores the pointer at this+0x180 and sets its vtable to PlaybackStateController. When the a2 flag is set, patches the dispatcher state at obj+0x14 to 4 and dispatches via obj+0x0. When the readiness flag at *(this+0x19C)+0x8 is set and this+0x114 < 2, patches the state to 46 and dispatches; then runs VertexBufferOffsetSetup and derives a per-element factor of this+0x114 + 2 (else this+0x114). Finally, while a count at this+0x20 is non-zero, walks the sub-struct array at *(this+0xC4) (21 DWORDs each) and allocates a frame buffer slot per element through the sub-allocator vtable entry at *(this+0x4)+0x8, sizing each slot from the element's dimension fields and the derived factor; returns the last processed slot index.

operations.description: Allocate the 80-byte media buffer through the sub-allocator vtable entry at *(this+0x4)+0 with arguments (this, 1, 80)
Store the allocated buffer pointer at this+0x180 and write the PlaybackStateController vtable pointer into the buffer's first field
When the a2 flag is set, set the dispatcher state at obj+0x14 to 4 and dispatch through the no-arg vtable entry obj+0x0
Branch on the audio readiness flag byte at *(this+0x19C)+0x8
When the readiness flag is set and the value at this+0x114 is less than 2, set the dispatcher state at obj+0x14 to 46 and dispatch through the no-arg vtable entry obj+0x0
Run VertexBufferOffsetSetup(this) when the readiness flag is set
Derive the per-element frame size factor: this+0x114 + 2 on the readiness path, otherwise the value at this+0x114 unchanged
Loop only runs while the element count at this+0x20 is greater than 0
Walk the sub-struct array whose base is *(this+0xC4), advancing 21 DWORDs per element, for the count at this+0x20

Allocate a frame buffer slot per element through the sub-allocator vtable entry at *(this+0x4)+0x8 with (this, 1, width, height-like terms): width = the element field at *(this+0xC4)+0x24 times the element field eight bytes before it, height = factor times (that same width field times the element field twenty-four bytes before it, divided by this+0x114)
Store each allocated slot pointer into the media buffer slot array that begins 8 bytes into the allocated object, one slot per element; the returned value is the final slot index
Return the last processed slot index (0 when the element count is not positive); invoked by sub_516C7B (00516c7b)
